{{Top|leg}}
A '''groundlimo''' was a chauffeur-driven [[Hovercraft|ground-effect vehicle]] that carried up to eight passengers. It was frequently employed by the affluent and influential classes. The groundlimo was the basic, unadorned version of the [[groundcoach]].
